records.text: Farmer Ray is a Hillsbrad Fields landowner targeted in the Forsaken campaign to disrupt local food supplies and infrastructure.
Deathstalker Lesh is a Forsaken scout assigned to reconnoiter Hillsbrad. He urgently sends Darthalia a coded warning that the town is ripe for attack.

High Executor Darthalia commands the Forsaken campaign from Tarren Mill under Varimathras and the Dark Lady. She drives a ruthless offensive against Hillsbrad and Dun Garok, demanding obedience and threatening punishment for delay. Lesh's warning prompts her to declare Hillsbrad ripe for attack; she later praises effective work while pressing the campaign forward.

Apothecary Lydon is a Royal Apothecary Society researcher in Tarren Mill, devoted to the New Plague and the Dark Lady. He seeks ingredients for his killing agents and elixirs, including mountain lion blood, bear tongues, and creeper ichor, and prepares a toxin for testing. His grim humor turns the work into entertainment: he welcomes a chance to use a contagious plague on dwarves and jokes that the smell of formaldehyde makes Umpi nervous.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is a former Stormwind city guard transferred to Southshore, where Captain Redpath assigns him work against the murlocs. Farren complains about the harbor stink and admits he can barely rouse himself to fight the murlocs; he asks the player to do the work. Redpath’s demand for proof leads Farren to seek murloc heads for approval. He also admits he cannot handle naga, though he sees a possible promotion or reassignment in the threat and asks for help.

Krusk is an orc warrior sent by the Warchief with other fighters to Durnholde to retrieve an object and investigate the Syndicate. The humans captured members of the expedition, though Krusk escaped. He directs efforts to free Drull and Tog’thar, then pursues the captured leader Gol'dir and continues the Warchief’s pendant mission. He says he follows the Warchief’s commands without claiming to understand them.

Tog’thar is an orc warrior captured at Durnholde during the expedition sent to investigate the Syndicate and retrieve an object for the Warchief. The humans separated him from Drull and imprisoned him. After release, he urges the rescue of Drull and insists that the humans will not keep him from freedom, even if he slows the rescuer down.

Drull is an orc warrior from the Warchief’s Durnholde expedition, captured by the humans and held apart from Tog’thar. Once free, he asks whether Tog’thar has also been rescued and says he will make his own way to Tarren Mill. His words present him as determined to regain his freedom and reunite with his fellow captive.

A Syndicate shadow mage operating among the organization’s forces in the Durnholde Keep ruins. Sylvanas’s authorities have declared Syndicate members wanted dead there; the available evidence gives this mage a combat role, but no individual service or personal history.
A cave yeti, one of the hostile wild creatures found in the Alterac region. It has no recorded service or spoken role in the supplied evidence.
A ferocious yeti of the Alterac region. When badly wounded it can go into a frenzy, and its recorded combat behavior includes Enrage.

A Syndicate rogue among the forces amassing in the Durnholde Keep ruins. Sylvanas’s authorities have declared Syndicate members wanted dead, and the posted bounty calls for proof of their deaths. This rogue’s native combat script uses Backstab; no individual service or personal history is established.

A Syndicate watchman among the forces amassing in the Durnholde Keep ruins. Sylvanas’s authorities have declared Syndicate members wanted dead, and the posted bounty calls for proof of their deaths. The watchman’s combat script uses Torch Burst; no individual service or personal history is established.

Marshal Redpath directs Southshore’s response to nearby threats. He warns that Crushridge ogres in the Alterac ruins could move toward the foothills and Southshore, and sends hunters after them to keep them from approaching Alliance territory. He also asks Lieutenant Farren Orinelle to focus on naga along the Eastern Strand and report back. Redpath thanks Farren’s helper for bringing the naga heads, recognizing the work needed to protect Southshore.
A Hillsbrad tailor who offers goods for browsing. The available evidence establishes a merchant service but gives no individual history or personal concern.

An apprentice in Hillsbrad’s blacksmithing trade, this smith sells goods and works in a shop whose stock includes iron sought by the Horde campaign against the town. Darthalia’s orders distinguish the apprentices from Blacksmith Verringtan, their master.

A farmer in the Hillsbrad countryside, caught up in the Horde campaign to disrupt the town’s food supply. Darthalia’s orders target farmers alongside farmhands and identify Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz separately.

A Hillsbrad peasant among the townsfolk the Horde says fled toward the southern fields after raids on the northern farms. Darthalia’s orders call for peasants hiding in the orchards to be hunted down.
A footman in the Hillsbrad area, equipped to use Defensive Stance in combat. The supplied records establish no personal history or allegiance beyond the name and combat role.

A miner working in the Hillsbrad region, where the Azurelode Mine supplies iron to Alliance armories according to Horde intelligence. Darthalia’s orders target the miners as part of a campaign against the mine; they do not establish this miner’s individual allegiance.
A Hillsbrad Sentry serves as a sentry in Hillsbrad. When badly wounded, it flees for assistance.

Magistrate Henry Maleb is Southshore’s newly assigned magistrate, investigating the Syndicate’s suspected role in the previous magistrate’s assassination. He sees the group as a threat to Southshore and directs efforts against its members and leadership. He is wary of Syndicate agents and speaks defiantly when attacked.

Loremaster Dibbs is a scholar in Southshore who works to recover and preserve the books left in Alterac’s ruins. He is especially interested in The Arm of Gri’lek, an account of ancient troll lore, and studies it after its recovery. He also examines an encrypted letter, but admits that his knowledge of encryption is limited; he sends it to his Ironforge colleague Prospector Stormpike, whom he considers capable of reading it. Dibbs helps catalogue the other recovered books for Milton Sheaf’s collection in Stormwind.

Melisara directs the campaign against Mug’Thol and the Crushridge ogres occupying Alterac’s ruins. She orders the ogres’ numbers reduced before moving against their leader, then targets his lieutenants and the Crown of Will. She serves the Dark Lady’s interests and treats resistance to them as grounds for a public example: she plans to display Mug’Thol and his lieutenants’ heads on pikes above Alterac. Her manner is brisk and unsentimental; she says she has little patience for idle chatter.

Captured Farmers are imprisoned people in Alterac who greet the arrival of drink with relief. They are thirsty enough to thank their captors for the water and for Shindigger Stout, and one raises a mug to inspect it before frowning. Their brief remarks convey immediate relief at being given something to drink; the supplied evidence gives them no individual names or distinct personal histories.

Captain Ironhill is identified as the leader of Dun Garok during the Hillsbrad conflict, making him a central target in the Horde assault described in the Battle of Hillsbrad. In combat, he can use Stoneform and Pummel.

Foreman Bonds is named as the foreman of the Azurelode Mine, which the Battle of Hillsbrad describes as an Alliance-controlled source of iron ore for Alliance armories. When badly wounded, he summons a Dun Garok soldier; he also uses Devotion Aura and can stun a nearby opponent with Hammer of Justice.

Magistrate Burnside is named as a leader of Hillsbrad, whose people are described as rallying around their leadership despite heavy losses. The Battle of Hillsbrad also links him with the town council, its proclamation, and its registry as targets of the Horde campaign. In combat he casts Fireball and Inferno Shell.
Dun Garok Mountaineers are part of the stronghold’s defenses, and the Battle of Hillsbrad names them among the defenders targeted in the Horde assault. A mountaineer can cast Devotion Aura.
Dun Garok Riflemen are a combat presence in the stronghold and are named among the targets of the Battle of Hillsbrad. They shoot at opponents.
A Dun Garok priest who fights alongside the stronghold’s defenders, striking with Holy Smite and healing injured allies before fleeing for assistance when badly hurt.
An elder moss creeper, a hostile creature that attacks with corrosive poison. It inhabits several parts of Hillsbrad.
A giant moss creeper, a hostile creature that attacks with corrosive poison and occurs across several regions.
Innkeeper Anderson welcomes weary travelers at his inn. He offers lodging and goods, explains the inn’s services, and has a seasonal Trick or Treat option.

Merideth Carlson is Southshore's horse breeder and has developed a feed intended to nourish spiritual horses. She says the Silver Hand and others dismissed the idea as madness, and demands special biscuits and gold as compensation for that treatment. In the quest exchange, after a paladin brings the requested supplies, she admits she misjudged them and offers to provide more feed without charge, while keeping the gold.
Hillsbrad farmhands work the northern farms of Hillsbrad Fields. Darthalia targets them in a campaign to disrupt the area’s food supply and infrastructure.
Tamara Armstrong is a humanoid found in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Hemmit Armstrong is a humanoid found in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Apprentice Honeywell is a humanoid in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Neema is a waitress in Hillsbrad. Visitors can browse her goods.
Bront Coldcleave is a butcher in Hillsbrad. Visitors can browse his goods.
Barkeep Kelly is a bartender in Hillsbrad. Visitors can browse her goods.

Donald Rabonne is a fishing trainer in Hillsbrad. He offers a training option; conditional replies point learners whose skill exceeds his toward Old Man Heming in Booty Bay for a fishing book, or toward Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh for further training.
A Daggerspine Shorestalker in Hillsbrad can use Defensive Stance in combat.
Daggerspine Shorehunters are naga whom Lieutenant Farren Orinelle regards as a threat. Farren admits he cannot handle them and seeks help against the shorehunters and sirens.
A Daggerspine Screamer is a naga encountered in the Hillsbrad region. It can unleash a deafening screech in combat, making it a dangerous close-range opponent.

A Daggerspine Siren is a naga found in the Hillsbrad region. It fights with Lightning Bolt; Lieutenant Farren Orinelle identifies Sirens as a threat to the coast, though that account comes from his request for help rather than from the Siren itself.
A Mudsnout Gnoll is a gnoll encountered in the Hillsbrad region. It attacks nearby opponents by slinging mud, giving it a short-range fighting style.
A Mudsnout Shaman is a gnoll encountered in the Hillsbrad region. It uses Lightning Bolt in combat, setting it apart from the nearby Mudsnout Gnolls that sling mud at close range.
A Torn Fin Muckdweller is a murloc found around the Hillsbrad coast. It can inflict an infected wound on nearby opponents, making close contact hazardous.
A Torn Fin Coastrunner is a murloc found around the Hillsbrad coast. It throws weapons in combat, giving it a ranged attack distinct from the Muckdweller's close-range infected wound.
A Torn Fin Oracle hunted with the Tidehunters in Lieutenant Farren Orinelle’s request against the Western Strand murlocs, it uses lightning and Healing Wave and flees for help when badly hurt.
A Torn Fin Tidehunter hunted with the Oracles in Lieutenant Farren Orinelle’s request against the Western Strand murlocs, it uses Frost Nova when foes come close.
Kundric Zanden is a town historian who calls for guards when endangered and tries to flee for help.
Caretaker Smithers calls for guards when endangered and tries to flee for help.
Nandar Branson is an alchemy-supplies merchant who offers goods to browse. When endangered, Nandar calls for guards and tries to flee for help.
Micha Yance is a trade-goods merchant who offers goods to browse. When endangered, Micha calls for guards and tries to flee for help.

Darren Malvew is a Southshore stablehand who has lost horses to undead, the Syndicate and other troublemakers, but sees mountain lions descending from Alterac as the greatest menace to them. He challenges would-be heroes to deal with the lions.
Lindea Rabonne is a Southshore fishing-supplies merchant. She offers goods to browse and calls for the guards when threatened.
A Southshore guard whose response to danger is to flee for assistance.
A Hillsbrad town councilman caught up in the Battle of Hillsbrad. Horde orders identify the council as a target alongside Magistrate Burnside; the councilman uses frost magic in a fight.
Innkeeper Shay tends an inn where travelers can rest, browse goods, or make it their home. The inn also offers a seasonal Trick or Treat interaction.
Zarise is a bat handler who offers fast travel. When intruders provoke an attack, she cries an alarm and calls enraged felbats to the fight.
Aranae Venomblood is an herbalism trainer.

Serge Hinott is an alchemy trainer whose work includes poisons and antidotes. In the exchange concerning Zanzil's mixture, he is intrigued by its effects, examines the toxin, and prepares a cure, while saying he can teach poison-making and use. He can be impatient with interruptions, brusquely directing a visitor to bother “Mr. High-And-Mighty” instead.
Delia Verana is a humanoid found in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Christoph Jeffcoat is proud of his secret turtle-bisque recipe, joking that people would return from the dead for a bowl. He says work keeps him from hunting snapjaws himself and asks for their meat to make the dish. He also complains that Alliance forces have come too close in the area.
Mallen Swain supplies tailoring goods and offers customers the option to browse his wares.
Vinna Wayne is a humanoid found in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Hans Zandin spent his life tending the orchard, pruning and nurturing its trees. Now he sees their rot and barrenness as mirroring his own dead, decaying state, and mourns that they have withered as he has.
Derak Nightfall is identified as a cook and vendor. He introduces himself by name.
Tara Coldgaze is a humanoid found in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Daryl Stack is a tailoring trainer who calls the place drafty and jokes, “what do I care? I’m dead.”
Craig Hewitt is a humanoid found in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Kayren Soothallow is a general goods vendor who offers visitors a chance to browse her goods.
Shara Blazen is a humanoid in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Farmer Getz is a landowner in Hillsbrad Fields. Darthalia singles out Getz and Farmer Ray in her campaign to disrupt Hillsbrad’s food supply and infrastructure.
Blacksmith Verringtan is a Hillsbrad blacksmith with a goods-browsing interaction.
A Tarren Mill Deathguard is a guard who raises the alarm when intruders appear.

Magus Wordeen Voidglare came to Tarren Mill to research, but the theft of Forsaken artifacts drew him into a crisis. He wants the stolen items returned and also sees the ruins around Dalaran as a place to search for valuable magical treasures. He is willing to send others against the patrols guarding those ruins.

Deathguard Samsa resents being stuck on guard duty while others fight Hillsbrad's humans, and eagerly collects their skulls. He speaks of the collection with striking enthusiasm, calling the skulls beautiful and looking forward to hearing how many humans have been killed.

Deathguard Humbert was sent by High Executor Darthalia to watch Dun Garok, but lost his gear when he left his camp to gather firewood. He is anxious that Darthalia will discover his mistake and deeply attached to his sword, which he describes as making him feel complete when it is returned.
Jailor Eston is a jailor in Hillsbrad who can cast Enslave in combat.
Jailor Marlgen is a Dark Iron dwarf jailor who fights with a ranged weapon. His combat calls warn opponents not to cross a Dark Iron and invoke the power of the Dark Iron Dwarves.

Novice Thaivand is the apprentice of the slain wizard Helcular. Outraged that a Southshore mob killed Helcular and buried him in the town cemetery, Thaivand seeks vengeance against Southshore. He seeks Helcular's rod and directs its use in the ritual meant to carry out that revenge.

Chef Jessen takes pride in Southshore's cuisine and his secret turtle bisque recipe, which he says draws visitors from as far as Darkshire. He has stopped hunting Snapjaws near Lake Lordamere because the area has become too dangerous, and asks for turtle meat so he can make the bisque again.
Darla Harris is a gryphon master. Her flight menu asks where a traveler would like to fly, and she calls for guards when attacked; an enraged gryphon is summoned during the attack.

Southshore's crier warns the town of approaching assassins and rallies its guards to protect the Magistrate. His urgent calls can turn personal when attackers strike, and he cries out for the Magistrate’s safety.
A farmer named Kent.

Keeper Bel'varil serves as an intermediary for Magus Voidglare's elemental research, asking for stone tokens and binding bracers. He knows his undeath has cost him his comedic timing, but thanks those who serve the Magus and, through him, the Dark Lady.

Bartolo Ginsetti is a boastful tailor who promises a world-famous Yeti Fur Cloak and insists that no cloak can surpass his work. He calls for wool, a Hillman's Cloak, fine thread and yeti fur, then claims to work his magic with needle and thread.

A Hillsbrad human identified as Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, named in High Executor Darthalia’s bounty notice as wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma. The notice presents him as one of four dangerous enemies it says are hiding.

A Hillsbrad human identified as Citizen Wilkes, named in High Executor Darthalia’s bounty notice as wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli. The notice presents him as one of four dangerous enemies it says are hiding.

A Hillsbrad human identified as Miner Hackett, named in High Executor Darthalia’s bounty notice as wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry. The notice presents him as one of four dangerous enemies it says are hiding.

A Hillsbrad human identified as Farmer Kalaba, named in High Executor Darthalia’s bounty notice as wanted for ambushing supplies from the Undercity. The notice presents him as one of four dangerous enemies it says are hiding.
Granistad is a beast that can yield a Long Elegant Feather, which Otho Moji’ko seeks for a message to the Wildhammer.
Kurdros is a beast that can yield a Long Elegant Feather, which Otho Moji’ko seeks for a message to the Wildhammer.
Hillsbrad Foreman has a combat support role: he casts Battle Command in combat and flees for assistance when badly hurt.
George Candarte sells leatherworking supplies and invites visitors to browse his goods.
Brewmeister Bilger is a Southshore brewer who receives Foggy MacKreel's moonshine as repayment of a debt. He welcomes the delivery and appreciates the drink; his brief greeting is a hiccup.

Phin Odelic leads adventurers investigating strange events and suspects the Forsaken are behind a possible new plague. Worried when his companions Quae and Kinelory go missing, he asks for help finding them. When told they are safe, he expresses relief, calls them irreplaceable friends and traveling companions, and hopes the group can uncover the Forsaken's plans. Under attack, he calls for guards.

Tallow challenges recruits to prove their combat skills before reporting to Drum Fel at Hammerfall. He describes the nearby Boulderfist ogres as a test and warns that Hammerfall is under attack; his brusque opening calls others weaklings.
Kris Legace is a freewheeling tradeswoman in the Hillsbrad region, with a routine goods-browsing service and a questgiver role.
Zixil, styled “Merchant Supreme,” is a merchant in the Hillsbrad region. He offers a routine goods-browsing service.
Overwatch Mark I is a named protector stationed in the Hillsbrad region.
Ott is a weaponsmith in the Hillsbrad region.
Hal McAllister is a fish merchant in the Hillsbrad region, with routine goods-browsing service. When badly hurt, he can flee for assistance, a brief glimpse of his response under attack.

Sarah Raycroft runs a general-goods service in the Hillsbrad region and has a questgiver role. Visitors can browse her goods. When badly hurt, she can call, “Guards! Help me!” and flee for assistance.
Jaysin Lanyda supplies poisons and reagents. In Southshore, visitors can browse his goods; he also offers quest-related interaction. (120-byte approx)
Robert Aebischer is a superior armorsmith who offers repairs and goods in Southshore. When badly threatened, he calls for the guards and tries to flee for help.
Jason Lemieux is a mushroom seller in Southshore. Visitors can browse his goods, and he also offers quest-related interaction.

Raleigh the Devout is a former Scarlet Crusader who came to reject the Crusade’s persecution of people it deemed plagued. He believes its leadership has become deranged and calls for its leaders to be removed, hoping the cause can be rekindled. When Brother Anton’s letter arrives, Raleigh reacts with alarm; after the Monastery’s leaders fall, he acknowledges the loss of life as a sacrifice to protect innocents.

Monika Sengutz is Vorrel Sengutz’s bereaved wife. She remembers him as a good mate, mourns his death, and resents the humans who tortured him. She thanks those who took revenge in his name, then asks to be left alone while she grieves.
The Condemned Acolyte is a hostile combatant whose attacks include Shadow Word: Pain.
The Condemned Monk is a hostile combatant who uses Kick in close fighting.
The Condemned Cleric is a hostile combatant who uses Holy Smite in battle.
The Cursed Paladin is a hostile combatant who uses Hammer of Justice against nearby opponents.
The Cursed Justicar is a hostile combatant who uses Strike against nearby opponents.
A Writhing Mage in Hillsbrad can cast Frostbolt in combat.
Wesley is a stable master who handles pet stabling and lost companions. When threatened, he calls for guards.
Theodore Mont Claire is a stable master who handles pet stabling and lost companions.
Tamra Stormpike is a humanoid from whom Humbert’s Sword can be looted.
Scargil is a humanoid from whom a Murloc Head and Torn Fin Eye can be looted.
Lady Zephris is a humanoid from whom a Daggerspine Scale can be looted.
Ro'Bark is an elite creature that uses a spell in combat.
Creepthess is a beast.
Big Samras is a beast whose combat behavior includes a spell.
Flik's Frog is a frog known for an unusual request to be kissed.

Sergeant Hartman is a Southshore sergeant focused on the town's safety during Hallow's End. He seeks intelligence on the Forsaken Wickerman Festival and help cleaning stink bombs; his words show sharp hostility toward the Forsaken. He also sells goods.
Rousch kneels, rises and salutes.

Advisor Duskingdawn is a Tarren Mill advisor who welcomes new arrivals and urges them to support the Forsaken, presenting cooperation as useful to both sides. He calls the Forsaken their new friends and says there is much to be done for them.
A Forsaken raider found in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Huraan is a Southshore researcher eager to study rare crystals from the Azurelode mine. Forsaken raiders seized the shipment, and Huraan fears its crystals may be the only known samples from the mine.
The Hillsbrad Flame Warden tends the Alliance festival fire in the foothills. The warden welcomes visitors who come to honor Alliance flames and urges them to desecrate Horde fires.
The Hillsbrad Flame Keeper tends the Horde festival fire in the foothills. The keeper welcomes visitors who come to honor Horde flames and urges them to desecrate Alliance fires.
A Crown Duster in Hillsbrad Foothills, listed among the targets in the Snagglebolt detectives' investigation near Hillsbrad Village.

place_records.text: You are in Hillsbrad Foothills, contested land in the Eastern Kingdoms where the Alliance and the Horde both hold settlements. The Alliance keeps Southshore on the coast and Hillsbrad Fields in the farmland, while the Horde holds Tarren Mill. Gray bears and mountain lions prowl the hills, moss creepers lurk in the woods, murlocs and Daggerspine creatures fill the coastal waters, and Crushridge ogres in the Alterac ruins threaten the foothills. Syndicate watchmen guard Durnholde Keep.

You are in Southshore, an Alliance harbor village in Hillsbrad Foothills. Marshal Redpath keeps watch against murlocs on the coast and ogres from the Alterac ruins, while Magistrate Henry Maleb hunts Syndicate members. Its inn and trainers serve the town.

You are in Tarren Mill, a Horde town in Hillsbrad Foothills. High Executor Darthalia commands the Forsaken campaign against Hillsbrad and Dun Garok from here, and Apothecary Lydon gathers mountain lion blood and bear tongues for his plague research.

You are in Durnholde Keep, a stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills held by Syndicate watchmen and rogues. Drull and Tog'thar, orc warriors from the Warchief's expedition, were taken prisoner here. Repairs and a vendor are available.

You are in Southpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills. Deathstalker Lesh, a Forsaken scout, watches Hillsbrad from here and sends urgent warnings to Darthalia that the town is ripe for attack. Gray bears and moss creepers roam nearby.

You are in Hillsbrad Fields, Alliance farmland in Hillsbrad Foothills. A Horde campaign aims to disrupt the town's food supply, and Farmers Ray and Getz are among its targets. Magistrate Burnside leads the people, who rally despite heavy losses. Repairs and a vendor are here.

You are in Azurelode Mine, an Alliance iron mine in Hillsbrad Foothills. Foreman Bonds runs it, supplying iron to Alliance armories, and Horde orders target its miners. Giant moss creepers and elder gray bears are the main dangers.
You are in Nethander Stead in Hillsbrad Foothills. Mudsnout gnolls and their shamans roam here, along with elder moss creepers and feral mountain lions.

You are in Dun Garok, an Alliance stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills. Captain Ironhill leads its riflemen, mountaineers and priests, and the Battle of Hillsbrad named it a target of the Horde assault. Elder moss creepers and feral mountain lions prowl outside.
You are in the Eastern Strand, a stretch of coast in Hillsbrad Foothills. Daggerspine sirens, shorestalkers, shorehunters and screamers haunt the shore.

You are in the Western Strand, a coastal stretch in Hillsbrad Foothills. Torn Fin murlocs fill its shallows, coastrunners, oracles and tidehunters among them, and the named creature Scargil roams here.
You are in Purgation Isle in Hillsbrad Foothills. Cursed paladins, writhing mages, condemned clerics and cursed justicars haunt its grounds.
You are in Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad Foothills. Vicious gray bears and starving mountain lions prowl here, and cave yetis and ferocious yetis are the greater danger.

You are in Thoradin's Wall, in Hillsbrad Foothills, where the Alliance and the Horde both hold settlements. George Candarte sells leatherworking supplies here and invites Horde visitors to browse his goods. A spirit healer offers a return to the living for a price, though it may not yet be your time. Elder gray bears and giant moss creepers roam the area.
